title: Chapter 98: There's Someone Behind You
html:
“You will die?” Fei Youliang frowned. He had asked for his future wife’s name. Why answer with a curse? The two had no connection, and he had followed every rule of the ritual. He had done nothing to anger the Pen Spirit.

He thought about it, and an answer came to him. This must be one of the preset designs. No matter what question I asked, these three words were destined to appear.

Convinced he had exposed the owner’s trick, Fei Youliang felt his confidence return.

“Making those words appear is an interesting mechanism. I haven’t worked it out yet, but the owner sacrificed logic for fear,” he explained. “An ordinary visitor might panic, break a taboo, and convince himself he had angered the Pen Spirit. Then those words would make him believe the spirit was real. Unfortunately for the owner, he got us. We followed every rule, yet the answer has nothing to do with my question. Therefore, this ritual is nothing more than a scare trick.”

Only after finishing his lecture did Fei Youliang realize that Zhu Jianing had not responded. He might as well have been speaking to a wall.

“Xiao Zhu? Why is your hand so cold?” He raised his head and saw Zhu Jianing was staring dumbly at the space behind him, his mouth wide open and his features twisted in abject fear.

“What are you looking at?”

Zhu Jianing’s expression unsettled him. The man seemed not to hear, and his whole body shook like the broken pen between their hands. Dread stirred in Fei Youliang’s chest. He sensed it too: the room’s atmosphere had changed. An indescribable presence had joined them, something that had not been there before, and it stood directly behind him.

He tried to turn, but a weight pressed down on his back, locking every muscle. “What is it? What’s behind me?”

Questions raced through his mind. The need to look—and the terror of what he might see—nearly drove him mad.

“Xiao Zhu, tell me, what are you seeing? What is behind me?!”

Cold flooded his body as though he had been dropped into an icy cave. Fei Youliang shuddered, and purple bruises bloomed across his skin beneath the grip of invisible hands.

The thing behind him seemed to be forcing its way into his body. The freezing weight on his shoulders grew heavier.

Across from him, Zhu Jianing gathered every scrap of strength to force out a warning.

“There’s someone behind you!”

“Behind me?”

The warning had two possible meanings: someone stood behind him, or someone was literally on his back. As Fei Youliang’s mind raced, Zhu Jianing sprang from the floor, tore his hand free, and bolted from the room.

Zhu Jianing did not hesitate or even turn around once in his escape.

Abandoned, Fei Youliang sat frozen on the floor. The pen clung to his hand; no matter how violently he shook it, it would not fall. Then his arm locked, seized by an outside force, and the pen began writing across the paper by itself.

“YOU WILL DIE! YOU WILL DIE! YOU WILL DIE!”

Blood-red curses covered the paper. Zhu Jianing was gone, and Fei Youliang alone held the pen. He had not moved his hand. Something else in the room was writing through him.

Even then, Fei Youliang clung to reason. An adrenaline junkie and a committed skeptic, he trusted scientific logic above all else.

Xiao Zhu probably saw a projection. The chairs force visitors to perform the ritual in one fixed position, so carefully chosen angles could create a convincing illusion. That must be the trick—but then why is my body shaking?

He had underestimated both the broken pen and the Haunted House. Given another chance, he would have prepared properly—and chosen a better partner.

The chill spread across his back. Spent by its frenzy, the pen finally shattered in his palm. The last word it wrote before falling free was “DIE.”

Is it over?Feeling returned to Fei Youliang’s arm, and relief escaped him in a shaky breath. He tried to warm his rigid muscles—then realized the pressure still weighed on his shoulders. He remained unable to move.

He had thought he had survived the Pen Spirit game. The true horror had only begun.

Why still can’t I move?Fei Youliang turned his neck inch by aching inch. He narrowed his eyes, braced for the worst—and found nothing behind him.

Nothing? Then why did Xiao Zhu react like that? What did he see?

Fei Youliang’s mind raced as the pressure intensified, as though someone stood upon his shoulders.

Shoulders? Stepping on them?

An image flashed through his mind, and Fei Youliang slowly raised his head.

Raven-black hair veiled her head. Asphyxiation had bloated her face, and fury rimmed the eyes bulging from their sockets.

A hanged woman stood on Fei Youliang’s shoulders.

His mouth opened, but no sound emerged. Every hair on his body rose, and his glasses slid slowly down his face. For one terrible moment, his heart seemed to stop.

“I…”

Before he could finish, his gaze lost focus and his body crumpled to the floor.

…

Chen Ge waited several minutes before entering Mu Yang High School, giving the two visitors time to venture deeper inside.

I haven’t heard any screams for so long… looks like I underestimated those two.

After putting on the skin mask, Chen Ge’s first destination was the Sealed Classroom. He placed the paper box with the twenty-four name tags on the lectern. The tables and chairs have been moved. They have been here and probably stumbled across something.

What they had encountered, Chen Ge could not guess. Even he had yet to understand the sealed classroom’s secret.

After restoring the desks and chairs and returning the papers and textbooks to the drawer, Chen Ge heard footsteps at the nearby junction. Someone was running through the corridor.

Who could that be?He put on the bloodied coat and the mask made from multiple human faces and slowly slipped out of the classroom.
